text:
mira: Cutover in 25m. PR #4298 (kv-cache OOM guard) is ready but needs dual approval before merge. I fixed the race in allocator and re-ran smoke. Can someone take a quick look? :pray:

sam: I can jump on it. Which files changed at a high level?

mira: Main changes: runtime/kv/allocator.cc (race fix), tests/kv/smoke.sh updated to include larger workload. CI green on linux, flaky mac runner failed once but was requeued.

cheng: pinging to confirm there are no perf regressions — did you benchmark tail-latency?

mira: quick check with local perf harness: p50 unchanged, p99 +2ms under worst-case; the extra checks are guarded behind a flag. snippet:

```
# perf output (local)
p50: 12.3ms
p95: 48.7ms
p99: 127.9ms (+2.1ms)
```

sam: okay looks fine to me. left 1 nit on allocator.cc (small rename). once that's fixed i'll give LGTM. :+1:

ops-jae: i'm on-call but can provide second OK if no infra risk. do we have a rollback plan if this spikes?

mira: rollback plan: if traffic shows errors, we flip kv-guard flag to old behavior via config; autoscaler policy doesn't change. ops playbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/kv-rollback (cc @ops-jae).

sam: resolved nit in a tiny follow-up commit (force-pushed). CI queued again: `./scripts/retry-ci.sh 4298`

release-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: CI queued for PR #4298 — linux/amd64 queued, macos queued, smoke-tests queued. Cutoff window closes at 1800000100.

mira: thanks. I also added a CI-only test to guard allocation under stress; should be safe.

ops-jae: reviewed the rollback steps, good. I can approve now. giving my OK. :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM from me too, merging after final smoke passes. :hammer_and_wrench:

release-bot: :white_check_mark: CI success for PR #4298 — all checks passed. Merge scheduled.

mira: merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

sam: great teamwork — monitoring charts for next 30m. ping me if anything looks off. :eyes:

cheng: I'll watch p99 and error rate dashboards.

mira: update: merged at 1800000075, canary rolling to 5% now.

ops-jae: noted. will escalate if error rate > 0.5% or p99 increases > 15%.

mira: closing thread — will post postmortem if anything unexpected occurs.
